title: Uko Wakuramo Videwo za Facebook Ukazibika muri Gallery
description: Uko wakuramo videwo za Facebook ukazibika muri Gallery ya Android na iPhone nta app. Koporora link ya videwo rusange, uyomeke kuri I Need Save, ukuremo.
photoCaption: Videwo iri ku nyandiko rusange ya Facebook.
photo2Caption: Videwo rusange gusa ni zo zishobora gukurwamo.
body:
Facebook yuzuyemo videwo zishimishije, kuva ku buryo bwo guteka, inama zo guhinga, uduce tw'imikino, kugeza kuri videwo zisekeje zo mu matsinda ukunda. Ikibabaje ni uko nta buto ihari yo kuzibika ako kanya muri Gallery. Muri iyi nyandiko uriga uko wakuramo videwo za Facebook ukazibika muri Gallery ya telefoni ukoresheje I Need Save, igikoresho cy'ubuntu gikorera kuri interineti ushobora gukoresha nta app kandi nta kwinjira.

Ukeneye Iki?

Ibyo ukeneye ni bike cyane:

  • Telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa ifite mushakisha na interineti.
  • Link ya videwo ya Facebook iri ku nyandiko rusange.
  • Umwanya muto usigaye mu bubiko bw'igikoresho cyawe.

Ni ibyo gusa. Ntukeneye gufungura konti kuri I Need Save, kandi ntukeneye gushyiramo amakuru yawe yo kwinjira kuri Facebook.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo za Facebook kuri Telefoni

Kurikiza izi ntambwe, waba ukoresha Android cyangwa iPhone:

  1. Fungura app ya Facebook maze ushake videwo ushaka kubika.
  2. Kanda buto ya Sangiza (Share) iri munsi ya videwo.
  3. Hitamo Koporora link (Copy link).
  4. Fungura mushakisha (browser), ujye kuri ineedsave.com.
  5. Omeka link mu gasanduku kabugenewe, cyangwa ukande buto ya Omeka.
  6. Kanda Kuramo maze utegereze urutonde rw'amahitamo rugaragare.
  7. Hitamo ubwiza bwa videwo wifuza. Gukuramo biratangira.

Kuri videwo zimwe, buto ibanza kwandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…. Ibi bibaho iyo videwo ikeneye gutunganywa, urugero guhuza amashusho n'amajwi cyangwa guhindura stream ikaba MP4. Tegereza gusa, kuko gukuramo biratangira ubwabyo dosiye imaze kwitegura.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo za Facebook kuri Mudasobwa

Kuri mudasobwa igendanwa cyangwa PC, intambwe zirasa. Fungura Facebook muri mushakisha, ukande kuri videwo ushaka, hanyuma ukoporore link yayo ukoresheje menu ya Sangiza cyangwa aho bandika aderesi. Fungura urupapuro rwo gukuramo muri tab nshya, womeke link, ukande Kuramo, maze uhitemo rimwe mu mahitamo ahari. Dosiye izabikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads.

Ibyiza byo Gukoresha I Need Save

  • Ni ubuntu kandi nta app. Fungura gusa urubuga muri mushakisha ya telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa.
  • Nta kwinjira. Ntukeneye gushyira amakuru ya konti yawe ya Facebook ahantu na hamwe.
  • Ikora no ku zindi mbuga. Uretse Facebook, ushobora no kubika videwo za TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) n'izindi mbuga zishyigikiwe.
  • Iroroshye gukoresha. Urubuga ruboneka mu ndimi 93, harimo n'Ikinyarwanda.

Guhitamo Ubwiza bwa Videwo Bukwiye

Link imaze gutunganywa, I Need Save yerekana amahitamo menshi. Ibigaragara bishobora gutandukana kuri buri videwo:

  • Videwo mu bwiza butandukanye, urugero 360p, 720p cyangwa 1080p, bitewe na videwo y'umwimerere.
  • Amajwi mu bwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo.
  • Ifoto / Ifoto ntoya ya videwo.

Muri rusange, 1080p itanga ishusho igaragara neza kurusha izindi, 720p iringaniza ubwiza n'ingano, naho 360p ni yo izigama cyane interineti n'ububiko. Ibisobanuro birambuye biri mu nyandiko itandukaniro ry'ubwiza bwa videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p.

Kugira ngo Videwo Igaragare muri Gallery ya Telefoni

Iki ni cyo gice gikunze kuyobera abantu. Gukuramo nibirangira, videwo ntihita igaragara buri gihe muri Gallery. Dore impamvu.

Kuri Android

Videwo ibikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Akenshi app ya Gallery irayigaragaza, ariko rimwe na rimwe bifata akanya gato. Niba itaragaragara, tegereza gato cyangwa ufungure ububiko bwa Downloads ukoresheje app icunga amadosiye.

Kuri iPhone na iPad

Niba wakuyemo ukoresheje Safari, videwo ijya muri app ya Files, mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Kugira ngo uyimurire muri app ya Photos:

  1. Fungura app ya Files maze winjire mu bubiko bwa Downloads.
  2. Kanda kuri videwo umaze gukuramo.
  3. Kanda buto ya Share.
  4. Hitamo Save Video.

Ubu videwo iri muri Gallery kandi ushobora kuyireba nk'izindi videwo. Dosiye za MP4 ziva kuri I Need Save zifite igihe nyacyo, bityo zikina neza muri app ya Gallery.

Inama: Niba ukunze gukuramo videwo nyinshi, jya usukura ububiko bwa Downloads buri gihe kugira ngo ububiko bwa telefoni butuzura vuba.

Videwo ya Facebook Yanze Kuvamo?

Hari ubwoko bw'ibikubiyemo budashobora gukurwamo:

  • Videwo ziri kuri konti cyangwa amatsinda byihariye.
  • Ibikubiyemo bishobora kurebwa gusa nyuma yo kwinjira.
  • Videwo zabujijwe mu turere tumwe.

Reba kandi neza ko link wometse ari iya videwo, atari iy'urupapuro cyangwa profili. Niba ushidikanya, yongere uyikoporore ukoresheje buto ya Sangiza kuri videwo.

Umutekano n'Inshingano

Videwo iva kuri Facebook ijya ako kanya ku gikoresho cyawe kandi ntibikwa kuri seriveri ya I Need Save. Nubwo bimeze bityo, koresha ibyo wakuyemo ku giti cyawe gusa. Ubaha uburenganzira bw'uwakoze videwo: saba uruhushya mbere yo kuyongera gushyira ku rubuga, kandi uvuge izina rya nyirayo.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ese nshobora gukuramo videwo za Facebook nta app?

Yego. I Need Save ikorera muri mushakisha ako kanya, bityo ntukeneye gushyiramo app n'imwe.

Kuki videwo idahita igaragara muri Gallery?

Kuri Android, Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato kugira ngo yerekane amadosiye mashya. Kuri iPhone, videwo ibanza kujya muri app ya Files, hanyuma ugomba guhitamo Save Video kugira ngo ijye muri Photos.

Nshobora gukuramo ijwi gusa?

Yego. Hitamo Amajwi, haba mu bwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps.
